MediaItem.title: Media Item
MediaItem.description: A link to a media archive or specific file.

title.description: The name of the event or project.

description.description: A brief description of the media.

link.description: The URL to the Google Drive or media archive.

year.description: The year the media was created.

category.description: The category of the work (e.g., Photo, Video, Design).

createdBy.description: The UID of the user who added the item.

media_items.description: Collection of all media archive links.
